measured_with: pymcu build (real driver, no mocks); 'code bytes' = the driver-reported size excluding the interrupt vector table

embedded_blob.mir: one fdata record named __romfs_1_font5x8_bin inside main; verbatim copy, no runtime table entry

open_close_only.note: open/close are compile-time bookkeeping; the whole cost is the blob itself. There is no handle object and no filesystem table.

const_seek_only.note: a constant seek updates the compile-time position; nothing is emitted

const_seek_read_print.source: open + seek(7,0) + read(1) + total += b[0] + close + print(total)
const_seek_read_print.note: the read folds to a constant -- zero load instructions; the 276 bytes are the print machinery plus the program skeleton

runtime_seek_read_loop.source: open; while i < 5: seek(2 + total, 0); b = read(1); total += b[0]; i = i + 1; close; print(total)

runtime_control_no_file.source: same while-loop arithmetic and print without open/read

per_instruction.remaining_clamp: binary(-) 1282 - f__pos -> tmp; jge EOF guard
per_instruction.read: one alf __romfs_1_font5x8_bin[tmp] -> tmp_160 (single LPM sequence per read site)
per_instruction.pos_advance: f__pos += consumed (folds into the same binary op stream)
per_instruction.extra_ir_vs_control: +1 fdata record, +5 copy, +2 jge, +2 lbl, +1 aug, +1 alf (61 vs 47 IR instructions in main)

runtime_handle_cost.sram: 2 bytes for the f__pos register pair while the handle is live; 0 bytes of file content (no whole-file copy)

byte_identity_gate.includes: micropython-blink (142 B, main at 0x68), SPI/UART/I2C and param-heavy fixtures
byte_identity_gate.note: ROMFS emission and folds are gated on open() actually resolving to an embedded file; programs that never open a file take the old code paths verbatim

size_floor.breakdown: 40 bytes of user code + 102 bytes of interrupt vector table, counted as the sum of Intel HEX data records (same accounting as CompatMpBlinkToggleTests.FlashSize_Is142Bytes)

demandant.result: display.text('PyMCU', 0, 0, 1) + show() over unmodified adafruit_ssd1306 + adafruit_framebuf emits the same 43 I2C transactions as the CPython oracle, on both compiler frontends (4 tests green)
